units.sourceHTML: Lists have the ability to be added together via the ⟦CODE0⟧ operator. This is often known as concatenation.

units.sourceHTML: Removing elements #
units.originalInnerHTML: Removing elements #

units.sourceHTML:
The opposite of ⟦CODE0⟧ is ⟦CODE1⟧. It removes a single element from a
given position in the list.
units.originalInnerHTML: The opposite of insert is removeAt. It removes a single element from a given position in the list.

units.sourceHTML: To remove a specific value instead, use ⟦CODE0⟧. The first value that matches using regular equality will be removed.
units.originalInnerHTML: To remove a specific value instead, use remove. The first value that matches using regular equality will be removed.

units.sourceHTML: In both cases, all following items are shifted up to fill in the gap.
